title: Expectation under a coupling
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\kappa$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega\times\Omega$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Define their coupling inner product by the expectation, under $\kappa$, of $(x,y)\mapsto f(x)g(y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\kappa$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega\times\Omega$
